name: Coldtea.ai
description: An agentic development environment that combines terminal-based coding agents, visual QA agents for regression testing, and AI production monitoring. Enables teams to run multiple AI agents in parallel with shared context while automating testing and post-deployment monitoring in one integrated workspace.
community_quotes: When most dev environments focus on building faster, Coldtea takes a different, calmer approach, focusing on building better
The shared-workspace idea actually works - one agent reading a stack trace another pane dumped, without me copy-pasting it across
We use it to catch regressions and monitor our agents so our small and mighty team can move fast
Reached #1 Product of the Day on Product Hunt with 522 upvotes
Ranked #4 of the week on Product Hunt for August 7th, 2026

name: Dograh
description: An open-source voice AI agent infrastructure platform providing a self-hostable alternative to closed platforms like VAPI. Features visual flow builder, real-time speech-to-speech in 70+ languages, telephony integration, warm handoff to humans, and automatic QA. Connects with Claude Code via MCP for building voice agents.
community_quotes: Completely open source - nothing is gated. BSD-2 license, one command to install
Cloud offering costs $0.01 per minute with your own model keys vs $0.05 for Vapi and Retell
MCP native - connect Claude Code and build a voice agent by chatting with it
Reached #1 on Product Hunt today with 383 upvotes
Self-hostable so you own your stack and your data - no per-minute fees

name: Muse Code
description: Meta's first AI coding agent, a terminal-based system designed for large codebases. Powered by the Muse Spark 1.2 model, it can inspect entire repositories, create plans, and modify multiple files. Available for macOS and Linux as a beta tool.
community_quotes: Meta's entry into the terminal-native AI coding space to compete with Claude Code and OpenAI Codex
Like having a software engineer in your terminal
Designed for complex software development workflows with persistent AI agents

name: Deploy AI Agent
description: An AI-native DevOps workspace that deploys in 60 seconds with $0 forever pricing. Launched during the week of August 10, 2026 as part of the growing trend of AI agents revolutionizing how DevOps and Cloud teams operate by reducing errors and accelerating deployments.
community_quotes: AI agents are revolutionizing how DevOps and Cloud teams operate
Deploys in 60 seconds with $0 forever pricing
Part of August 2026 Product Hunt launches for DevOps AI tools
